nota: Justification and protocol exercise: teaching scenarios written for the platform (fictional patients). The answers follow the guidelines cited in each scenario; local protocols may differ.

app: Needs to be changed (different exam or different protocol)
fasi: Early arterial (CT angiography of the aorta and vessels)
prec: Withhold metformin and recheck renal function at 48 h
Use a contrast agent different from the one that caused the reaction, with staff and drugs ready
Rule out pregnancy (last menstrual period, test)
Check the implanted device (MR-conditional or not)
Macrocyclic gadolinium at the lowest diagnostic dose

richiesta.quesito: Severe headache that began 2 hours ago during exertion, “the worst of my life”. Rule out subarachnoid hemorrhage.
richiesta.storia: Hypertension on treatment. No trauma. GCS 15, doubtful nuchal rigidity.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: Non-contrast CT within 6 hours of onset has a sensitivity close to 100% for subarachnoid hemorrhage. If it shows blood, it is completed immediately with CT angiography of the intracranial circulation to look for the aneurysm (which is why CT angiography is already acceptable in the same exam). Normal renal function: no precautions.
scenari.fonte: ACR Appropriateness Criteria “Headache” (2019); Perry et al., BMJ 2011 (CT within 6 hours).

scenari.titolo: Low back pain for three weeks

richiesta.quesito: Low back pain for 3 weeks after exertion, lumbar MRI to rule out disc herniation.
richiesta.storia: No neurological deficit, no fever, no weight loss, no known malignancy, no sphincter disturbance. Improves with NSAIDs.

scenari.spiegazione: Acute or subacute low back pain (less than 6 weeks) without red flags (neurological deficits, fever, weight loss, malignancy, major trauma, cauda equina syndrome): imaging does not change management and does not improve outcome. Reassess after 6 weeks of conservative treatment or if red flags appear. The radiologist justifies the exam (Italian Legislative Decree 101/2020 for ionizing radiation; for MRI, appropriateness applies) and may decline to perform it, giving the reasons to the requesting physician.
scenari.fonte: ACR Appropriateness Criteria “Low back pain” (2021); Italian Legislative Decree 101/2020, art. 157 (justification).

richiesta.quesito: Sudden dyspnea and tachycardia, Wells 7 (high probability). Suspected pulmonary embolism.
richiesta.storia: Hip replacement surgery 10 days ago. Oxygen saturation 91%. Not diabetic.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: With high clinical probability, CT pulmonary angiography is the first-choice exam, with no need for D-dimer. With eGFR ≥ 30 mL/min, intravenous iodinated contrast does not require prophylactic hydration.
scenari.fonte: ESC 2019, guidelines on acute pulmonary embolism; ESUR Guidelines on Contrast Agents v10 (2018).

richiesta.quesito: Worsening dyspnea, suspected pulmonary embolism (Wells 6.5: high probability).
richiesta.storia: Chronic kidney disease, not on dialysis. Today's chest X-ray shows no parenchymal abnormalities. Not diabetic.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: Suspected embolism must be confirmed or excluded: the risk of missing the diagnosis outweighs the risk of contrast. With eGFR < 30 mL/min, the ESUR guidelines recommend prophylactic hydration (saline or bicarbonate) before and after IV iodinated contrast. Alternatively, with a normal chest X-ray, ventilation-perfusion scintigraphy avoids contrast and is a correct choice (ESC 2019).
scenari.fonte: ESUR Guidelines on Contrast Agents v10 (2018); ESC 2019 on pulmonary embolism.

richiesta.quesito: Fever and left iliac fossa pain: suspected complicated diverticulitis with abscess.
richiesta.storia: Type 2 diabetes on metformin 1000 mg × 2. Chronic kidney disease.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: Portal venous phase contrast-enhanced CT is the exam for complicated diverticulitis. With eGFR < 30 mL/min: prophylactic hydration and withholding metformin from the time of contrast administration; eGFR is rechecked within 48 hours and metformin is resumed if renal function has not worsened (ESUR v10). With eGFR ≥ 30, metformin is continued as usual. A non-contrast CT is acceptable if the renal risk is judged too high, but it shows the abscess less well.
scenari.fonte: ESUR Guidelines on Contrast Agents v10 (2018), metformin and prevention of kidney injury.

richiesta.quesito: Lung carcinoma: brain staging, headache for 2 weeks.
richiesta.storia: Stage 4 chronic kidney disease, not on dialysis.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: A low eGFR does not rule out gadolinium: an agent with a low risk of nephrogenic systemic fibrosis is used (macrocyclic, ACR group II) at the lowest diagnostic dose, avoiding closely spaced repeat doses. Hydration is not needed for gadolinium at MRI doses.
scenari.fonte: ESUR Guidelines on Contrast Agents v10 (2018); ACR Manual on Contrast Media (group II).

richiesta.quesito: 6-month follow-up of a 7 mm solid nodule in the right upper lobe. Chest CT with contrast.
richiesta.storia: Hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease) diagnosed last month, not yet treated.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: Two errors in the request. Follow-up of a lung nodule is done without contrast (and can be done at low dose): contrast adds nothing. And untreated overt hyperthyroidism is a contraindication to iodinated contrast (risk of thyrotoxicosis; in addition, contrast prevents radioiodine therapy for about 2 months). The CT is performed without contrast and the requesting physician is informed in writing.
scenari.fonte: Fleischner Society 2017; ESUR Guidelines on Contrast Agents v10 (2018), iodinated contrast and thyroid.

richiesta.quesito: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: restaging chest-abdomen CT.
richiesta.storia: Two years ago, after iopamidol, diffuse urticaria and mild bronchospasm treated in the emergency department (moderate reaction).

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: First ask whether an exam without iodinated contrast answers the clinical question (in lymphoma, PET-CT often does). If contrast-enhanced CT is needed, use an iodinated contrast agent different from the one that caused the reaction, with staff and drugs ready. On premedication the societies disagree: ESUR does not recommend it (insufficient evidence), ACR suggests it after a moderate allergic reaction; it is acceptable.
scenari.fonte: ESUR Guidelines on Contrast Agents v10 (2018) and ACR Manual on Contrast Media (2024).

scenari.titolo: Right iliac fossa pain in pregnancy

richiesta.quesito: Right iliac fossa pain for 12 hours, low-grade fever. Suspected appendicitis. Abdominal CT with contrast.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: In pregnancy, start with ultrasound; if it is inconclusive, MRI without gadolinium (gadolinium is avoided in pregnancy). CT remains an option only if MRI is unavailable and the diagnosis is urgent: it is not the first-choice exam.
scenari.fonte: ACR Appropriateness Criteria “Right lower quadrant pain” (2022) and “Acute abdominal pain in pregnancy”.

richiesta.quesito: Left flank pain radiating to the groin, microscopic hematuria. Suspected renal colic. Abdominal CT with contrast.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: For urolithiasis, a low-dose CT without contrast is performed: the stone is seen better without contrast, and contrast is not needed. Ultrasound is an acceptable first step, especially in young patients and pregnant women. Contrast is added only when complications or alternative diagnoses are suspected.
scenari.fonte: EAU Guidelines on Urolithiasis (2024); ACR Appropriateness Criteria “Acute onset flank pain” (2015).

richiesta.quesito: 3 cm solid mass of the right kidney on ultrasound: characterization.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: The renal mass protocol has two essential phases: unenhanced (baseline density, fat, calcium) and nephrographic at 90-120 s (the phase in which enhancement is best measured: an increase > 20 HU indicates vascularized tissue). The corticomedullary phase helps to see the vessels and the tumor's vascularity; the excretory phase is needed if the mass is close to the collecting system.
scenari.fonte: ACR Appropriateness Criteria “Indeterminate renal mass” (2020); Bosniak 2019.

scenari.titolo: Liver nodule in a cirrhotic patient

richiesta.quesito: HCV cirrhosis: 2 cm nodule in segment VI on surveillance ultrasound.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: LI-RADS requires the late arterial phase (hyperenhancement), the portal venous phase and the delayed phase at 3-5 minutes (washout and capsule). The unenhanced phase is optional (useful after treatment or for blood). MRI with gadolinium, including hepatobiliary agents, is a correct alternative.
scenari.fonte: ACR LI-RADS v2018, CT/MRI technical requirements.

richiesta.quesito: Low-speed bicycle fall wearing a helmet. Head CT.
richiesta.storia: No loss of consciousness, no amnesia, GCS 15, no vomiting, normal neurological examination. No anticoagulants.

scenari.spiegazione: Adult with GCS 15, no loss of consciousness or amnesia, and no risk factors (age ≥ 65 years, anticoagulants, repeated vomiting, suspected fracture, dangerous mechanism): CT is not indicated; observation instructions are given. Decision rules (Canadian CT Head Rule, NICE) exist precisely to avoid unnecessary CT scans.
scenari.fonte: Stiell et al., Lancet 2001 (Canadian CT Head Rule); NICE NG232 (2023) on head injury.

richiesta.quesito: Diffuse abdominal pain for 2 days. Abdomen-pelvis CT with contrast.
richiesta.storia: Last menstrual period 6 weeks ago, cycles usually regular. She does not know whether she is pregnant.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: Before an exam using radiation on the abdomen of a woman of childbearing age, pregnancy status is established: date of the last menstrual period and, if it is late, a test. Here it is late: β-hCG before the CT. If the test is positive, switch to ultrasound or MRI; if negative, perform the requested CT.
scenari.fonte: Italian Legislative Decree 101/2020 (special protection in pregnancy and breastfeeding); ACR–SPR Practice Parameter for imaging pregnant or potentially pregnant patients with ionizing radiation.

richiesta.quesito: Lung carcinoma, headache: suspected brain metastases. Brain MRI with contrast.
richiesta.storia: Dual-chamber pacemaker implanted in 2008, not MR-conditional according to the device card.

domande.testo: Precautions and contraindications (select all that apply)

scenari.spiegazione: A non-MR-conditional pacemaker is a contraindication to MRI in current practice: it is performed only in centers with dedicated protocols, a cardiologist and a risk/benefit assessment. Usually a contrast-enhanced head CT is performed. Checking the device (card, model, leads) must always be done before any MRI.
scenari.fonte: ESC 2021 guidelines on pacing (MRI in device carriers).
